name: @coti-io/sablier-payroll-pod-port
description: Sablier payroll PoD port user-story tests (Phase 2 — simCOTI + pToken)

scripts.compile: npm run link:contracts && npm run sync:sablier && npm run sync:contracts && (hardhat compile || npm run sync:artifacts)
scripts.test: npm run compile:sim && PRIVATE_KEY=0xac0974bec39a17e36ba4a6b4d238ff944bacb478cbed5efcae784d7bf4f2ff80 COTI_BACKEND=sim POD_PAYROLL_PORT_TESTS=1 SABLIER_PAYROLL_TESTS=1 hardhat test test/runner.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run compile:sim && PRIVATE_KEY=0xac0974bec39a17e36ba4a6b4d238ff944bacb478cbed5efcae784d7bf4f2ff80 COTI_BACKEND=sim PAYROLL_SYSTEM_E2E=1 hardhat test test/runner-e2e.ts
scripts.test:e2e:testnet: npm run compile && COTI_BACKEND=testnet PAYROLL_SYSTEM_E2E=1 hardhat test --no-compile test/runner-e2e-testnet.ts
scripts.test:e2e:live: npm run compile && PAYROLL_E2E_LIVE_SOURCE=1 hardhat test --no-compile test/runner-e2e-live.ts
scripts.test:testnet:smoke: npm run compile && COTI_BACKEND=testnet POD_PAYROLL_PORT_TESTS=1 SABLIER_PAYROLL_TESTS=1 hardhat test --no-compile test/runner-testnet-smoke.ts
scripts.test:testnet: npm run compile && COTI_BACKEND=testnet POD_PAYROLL_PORT_TESTS=1 SABLIER_PAYROLL_TESTS=1 hardhat test --no-compile test/runner-testnet.ts
scripts.deploy:testnet: npm run compile && COTI_BACKEND=testnet hardhat run scripts/deploy-testnet.ts
scripts.deploy:production: npm run compile && hardhat run --no-compile scripts/deploy-production.ts
scripts.deploy:fuji-coti: npm run compile && FORCE_REDEPLOY_PAYROLL=1 hardhat run --no-compile scripts/deploy-fuji-coti.ts
